historical_receipts.impact: Old profiles are historical and stale under the hardened profile. The admitted five-rewrite candidate has no helper changes, so the overlay does not change its actual helper bytes. Tampered plan/TRAP manifests are negative reproducers. No evidence of backend/source substitution in recorded runs; these were missing admission guarantees, not evidence that substitution occurred.
